leads.name: The Plane Tree of Via Baserga
leads.why_a_lead: Existence confirmed by both the MASAF register (sheet 21/C933/CO/03, girth 490cm per the earlier brief; RAMI's own field measurement reads 4.30m at 130cm height, close but not identical, likely a different point on the trunk or a later remeasurement) and the independent RAMI register (id 17613, 'Platano via Baserga', coordinates 45.784388,9.093731, health rated 'Buona'), which also lists a separate hornbeam (Carpinus betulus, RAMI id 17614) at the same address. RAMI's own 'Accessibilità' field rates the tree 'Accessibile', but this field measures how easy the tree is to physically reach/survey in the field, not whether the ground it stands on is public or private, so it does NOT settle the private-garden question. This pass could not find a street-level or satellite description confirming whether the tree stands on public street frontage at Via Baserga or inside a private garden; a similarly-named property 'Villa il Platano' turned out to be at a different address (Via Varesina 253) and is unrelated. 3.68km from centre, a separate southern cluster rather than part of the lakefront walk. CHECKED AGAIN 2026-08-14 (write pass, before writing): still unresolved, and the balance of evidence now leans private. MASAF's own locality field for sheet 21 is 'Via Baserga 39', a house number, and RAMI lists a second registered tree (a hornbeam) at the same address, which is the pattern of a garden rather than a street verge. Compare data/leads/brussels.json, where entries registered against a private house number are blocked for exactly this reason. A targeted web search and the ascuoladaglialberi.net page for the province of Como (which does describe other private-courtyard trees in the city, e.g. Via Cadorna 1/A) say nothing about Via Baserga at all. NOT written: access cannot be stated honestly, and the doubt is about somebody's home, which is the half of hard rule 10 that does not bend.
leads.next_step: Checked 2026-08-17 (Esri World Imagery, dated aerial, centred on the register point): the property reads as a residential compound, a swimming pool and enclosed garden between the house and the road, boundary wall along the street. Leans private but does not conclusively show whether the crown itself overhangs public pavement. Only remaining route is a genuine street-level view (Mapillary or similar CC-licensed source) showing the trunk's relationship to the wall; do not re-run a plain web search, it has now failed twice, and do not re-fetch the same aerial tile again, it will not change.

blocked.reason: Register sheets 20/C933/CO/03 (plane, girth 642cm; corrected 2026-08-15, previously mis-cited here as 03/C933/CO/03), 18/C933/CO/03 (magnolia, 228cm) and 14/C933/CO/03 (arbutus, no girth recorded).
